-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/shapes

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}

type T struct {
	name string
	n    int
	pos  Point
	grid [2]int
	tags []string
	idx  map[string]int
	ptr  *Point
}

func New() *T {
	return &T{name: "tee", n: 7, pos: Point{1, 2}, grid: [2]int{3, 4}, ptr: &Point{5, 6}}
}

func (r *T) Name() string        { return r.name }
func (r *T) N() int              { return r.n }
func (r *T) Pos() Point          { return r.pos }
func (r *T) Grid() [2]int        { return r.grid }
func (r *T) Tags() []string      { return r.tags }
func (r *T) Idx() map[string]int { return r.idx }
func (r *T) Ptr() *Point         { return r.ptr }

type Writer struct {
	n int
}

func (w *Writer) Name() string {
	w.n++
	return "writer"
}

-- w/same/same.lgo --
package same

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}

type IName interface {
	const Name string
}

type IN interface {
	const N int
}

type IPos interface {
	const Pos Point
}

type IGrid interface {
	const Grid [2]int
}

type NameT struct : IName {
	name string
}

func (r *NameT) Name() string { return r.name }

type NT struct : IN {
	n int
}

func (r *NT) N() int { return r.n }

type PosT struct : IPos {
	pos Point
}

func (r *PosT) Pos() Point { return r.pos }

type GridT struct : IGrid {
	grid [2]int
}

func (r *GridT) Grid() [2]int { return r.grid }

-- w/cross/cross.lgo --
package cross

import "example.com/shapes/lib"

type Named interface {
	const Name string
	const N int
	const Pos lib.Point
	const Grid [2]int
}

type Wrap struct : Named {
	*lib.T
}

func Make() Named {
	return &Wrap{lib.New()}
}

-- w/app/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/shapes/cross"
)

func main() {
	v := cross.Make()
	fmt.Println(v.Name, v.N, v.Pos, v.Grid)
}

package sameslice

	const Tags []string
}

	tags []string
